infeasible_output.note: bin capacity exceeded, knapsack over capacity, TSP printing only `0 0`

suboptimal.note: feasible with gaps of 4-398% (colours/bins/makespan not minimised)

crash_other.note: 3 program bugs; but 2 API misconceptions (solver.Value used while building the model), 1 invented method (SetServiceTime) and 2 header misreads (3 fields; a strict 4-field check) that the rules cannot catch

timeout.note: re-run also > 40 s (CP-SAT bin packing at 40 items)
